name: Carbon Credit
description: A tradable carbon credit (ERC-20) where 1 token = 1 tonne of CO2e (a Verified Carbon Unit). Minting issues credits from a verified project, transfers trade them between KYC-verified registry participants, and burning permanently retires a credit so it can never be double-counted. Freeze places a compliance hold on an account.

registry.description: Issuing registry, e.g. Verra / Gold Standard

vintage.description: Vintage year the credits were generated
